description: 南投縣政府消防局燃氣熱水器承裝業及其技術士合格名冊 [gas networks and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 南投縣政府. 請檢視居家燃氣熱水器，如有將屋外式熱水器（RF）安裝在有加裝窗戶的陽臺或屋內等通風不良場所，即有一氧化碳中毒危險，應委託「合格」承裝業技術士將熱水器遷移至屋外或更換為強制排氣式熱水器、電熱水器、太陽能熱水器，以維護生命安全。. Coverage: 南投縣政府. The portal files it under the publisher 南投縣政府. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-11-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
